sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Page imports
sections.what: Brings in the router tools and the three page components.
sections.why: Likely reason: the file needs these pieces to build the navigation and routes.
sections.watch_out: Renaming a page file breaks the matching import here.

sections.name: App
sections.title: Navigation bar and routes
sections.what: Draws the blue navigation bar with links to Dashboard and Settings, then lists the three routes that show each page.
sections.why: Likely reason: a single shell means every page has the same menu.
sections.watch_out: Links here move within the app without reloading, but the Create New Model link on the Dashboard does reload the page.

summary: Defines the top navigation bar and maps the three web addresses to their pages.
purpose: Sets the frame that every page sits inside and decides which page shows for each address.
why: Likely reason: keeps the menu and the list of routes in one place.
how: The router wraps the whole app. A blue bar shows a title link to the home page, a Dashboard link and a Settings link. The route list shows Dashboard at the root address, ModelWizard at the wizard address and Settings at the settings address.
inputs: The web address the user visits and clicks on navigation links.
outputs: The matching page shown under the navigation bar.
risks: Any address not in the route list shows only the navigation bar with no message.
debug: If a page does not appear, check the route path and the import at the top of the file. If a link does nothing, check its target address.
